High-Value Checkpoints: Caulk lines, grout, vanity base, toilet seal area, exhaust fan performance
Common False Positives: Soap film, mildew on residue, cosmetic staining
Escalation Triggers: Recurring spotting, bubbling drywall, sub-sink moisture
Homeowner Language: This area often has humidity-related spotting. Improve drying and check for leaks.
Professional Language: Bathroom conditions favor condensation-related growth; evaluate ventilation and concealed plumbing.
